title: Double Drip Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice 100ml Shortfill
description: Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice from Double Drip is a tantalising trio of fabulously fruity flavours given an invigorating icy finish that’s absolutely irresistible. Soft, succulent, sun-ripened Strawberry is balanced with the fresh ruby tang of Raspberry, while the bold, juicy sweetness of rich Red Cherry adds a little stone fruit sass to these Berry BFFs’ perfect pairing. This banquet of summer fruits is lifted even further with a bracing layer of frosty menthol that transforms this e-liquid experience into a refreshing fruit cocktail, swimming in crushed ice. Long-lasting 100ml Shortfill bottles from Double Drip offer the ideal way to personalize your favourite e-liquid flavours by adding nicotine to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots , giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Alternatively, leave out the nicotine entirely and simply enjoy the pure, delicious flavour and rich, billowing sub-ohm clouds. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as more economical and convenient alternative to smaller bottles of high-vg e-liquid. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils , ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production from your device. Discover the ultimate vaping experience with Double Drip E-Liquid, a hugely popular and influential vape juice brand proudly made in the UK. With a wide range of e-liquid formulations to suit all e-cigarette setups, Double Drip has an e-juice for every preference. Whether you prefer sub-ohm (high-VG) e-liquid , 50/50 e-liquid , Nicotine Salts , or long-lasting shortfills, Double Drip has you covered. Please note: This Shortfill contains a high concentrate of flavour when compared to 50ml Double Drip Shortfills
